ValidationRule.description: Forces the reviewer to document why a request reached a terminal state. Prevents silent data loss without justification.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Applied'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Ignored'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Closed') ), ISPICKVAL(Closed_Reason__c, ''), ISBLANK(Notes__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a Closed Reason or add a Note before closing this request.
